snippet.title: Hela: of Mice & Magic | Narrative Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover where the adventure begins in this new Extended CGI Story Trailer for Hela: of Mice & Magic.

When the Kind Witch can no longer care for the forest alone, she shares a little of her magic with the smallest of companions. See how her mouse familiars—and their magical Froggy Backpacks—came to be.

From the creators of the Unravel series, Hela is a heartfelt 3D open-world adventure. Explore a living playground inspired by Northern Sweden, solve playful puzzles using your Froggy Backpack and magical remedies, and play solo or in co-op.

Hela: of Mice & Magic launches December 1, 2026, on PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2.

Add it to your wishlist today: https://www.helagame.com/
